images.prompt:
A painted science-fiction character portrait for a strategy game. Head and shoulders, three-quarter view, looking just past the viewer. Grounded and believable: practical clothing and equipment with real materials and wear; any insignia or badges are plain geometric shapes. One warm key light from the side and a thin cool cyan rim light; a deep navy-black background with a faint, softly blurred field of stars. Muted palette, rich shadows, fine painterly brushwork, calm and observant mood.

Subject: An elected Elder of the Frontier Cooperative, a woman in her forties with sun-weathered skin and braided dark hair, in a practical blue work jacket with a small round pin; warm, determined, ready to argue.

Do not include: text, letters, numbers, logos, signatures, watermarks, frames, borders, black letterbox bars, user-interface elements, cartoon or anime style, glossy plastic skin, fantasy armour, extra fingers.

A painted widescreen illustration for a strategy game event. Grounded science fiction among real stars: believable ships, stations and worlds, true scale and starlight. One clear focal point that still reads on a small phone screen. A muted palette of deep navy, slate and warm starlight with small cyan accents. Painterly and cinematic, quiet rather than explosive.

Subject: A settlement of the Frontier Cooperative on a warm, hazy super-Earth: clusters of white habitat domes and green terraced farms on rolling hills, a shared landing field with small ships under blue lights, a pale yellow-orange sun a little smaller than ours in a golden, dusty sky.

Do not include: text, letters, numbers, logos, signatures, watermarks, frames, borders, black letterbox bars, user-interface elements, lens flares, cartoon style, busy clutter.
